{{For|a list of quests in [[Hollow Knight]]|Quests (Hollow Knight)}}

<b>Wishes</b> are a quest system in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> that [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] may accept from [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPCs]] found across [[Pharloom]] or from [[Wishwall]]s that can be found within [[Bone Bottom]], [[Bellhart]], or [[Songclave]]. They involve Hornet completing a wide variety of objectives, such as killing enemies, collecting items, or tracking down NPCs somewhere in the world. Ongoing wishes appear in the [[Tasks]] menu in the inventory.

Wishes are divided into 7 different categories:

== Wayfarer Wishes ==
[[File:Wayfarer Quest Icon.png|right|thumb|160x160px]]

Wayfarer Wishes usually involve finding an item or NPC during Hornet's exploration of Pharloom at the request of another NPC. Later in the game, some Wayfarer Wishes are placed that involve defeating optional [[Bosses (Silksong)|bosses]].

== Gather Wishes ==
[[File:Gather Quest Icon.png|right|thumb|160x160px]]

Gather Wishes involve exploring a region of the map (or in the case of the <i>[[Great Taste of Pharloom]]</i> wish, the entire map) and finding specific items to turn in to an NPC and complete the wish. Collecting the required items usually does not directly involve killing enemies, with some exceptions.

== Hunt Wishes ==
[[File:Hunt Quest Icon.png|right|thumb|160x160px]]

Hunt Wishes involve killing [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in a specific part of the world and collecting items dropped by them to turn in and complete the wish. The only exception to this is the <i>[[Dark Hearts]]</i> wish, which does not require Hornet to collect any items and whose enemies are found all across Pharloom.

They carry a high reward, either yielding a [[Heavy Rosary Necklace]] or a [[Mask Shard (Silksong)|Mask Shard]].

== Donate Wishes ==
[[File:Donate Quest Icon.png|right|thumb|160x160px]]
Donate Wishes involve donating either {{S|shell shards}} or {{R|rosaries}} to a [[Wishwall]] in order to help out a particular settlement, and cannot be accepted until Hornet has the required amount of resources to donate. Donate Wishes for a settlement must be completed in order, and are usually prerequisites for other wishes or obtaining items.

== Delivery Wishes ==
[[File:Delivery Quest Icon.png|right|thumb|160x160px]]

Delivery Wishes involve accepting a delivery item from the [[Couriers Tipp & Pill]] in Bellhart to give to another NPC somewhere else in Pharloom. Deliveries are fragile and take damage when Hornet does. Making a heavy landing, hitting a ceiling while using [[Silk Soar]], and running into a wall while using [[Swift Step]] also damages the item. If the item takes too much damage (denoted below Hornet's health bar), it breaks, and another one must be acquired from Tipp & Pill to re-attempt the delivery. Travelling with the [[Bellways]], [[Ventrica]], [[Flea Caravan]] or using the [[Beastling Call]] immediately destroys the item.

Although the [[Courier's Rasher]] delivery for the <i>[[Great Taste of Pharloom]]</i> wish functions in the same manner and displays the "Wish Promised" card when it's accepted, it does not count as its own Delivery Wish.

<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show List of Wishes" data-collapsetext="Hide List of Wishes">
{{TaskEntry
| top = true
| header = <b><i>Accessible in [[Act 2]]</i></b>
| id = Bone Bottom Supplies
| title = [[Bone Bottom Supplies]]
| description = "Goods for the camp at base, where pilgrims' journey starts. We muchly hope this delivering goes well!"
| objective = Deliver supplies to the fixer Flick in Bone Bottom.
| location = <b><i>[[Bellhart]] NPCs</i></b>
[[Couriers Tipp & Pill]]
| reward = {{R|150}}
}}
{{TaskEntry
| id = Pilgrim's Rest Supplies
| title = [[Pilgrim's Rest Supplies]]
| description = "Supplies for the rest-stop in the fields. We is used to like this delivering, when we was young and muchly brave."
| objective = Deliver supplies to Mort in Pilgrim's Rest.
| location = <b><i>[[Bellhart]] NPCs</i></b>
[[Couriers Tipp & Pill]]
| reward = {{R|180}}
}}
{{TaskEntry
| id = Queen's Egg
| title = [[Queen's Egg (Wish)|Queen's Egg]]
| description = <i>"We is got requested times a'many for this, a queeny egg of those eaters of Silk. Wish from big, sticky creature, near many roaches caged. Wants it muchly!"</i>
| objective = Deliver the Queen's Egg to Styx of Sinner's Road.
| location = <b><i>[[Bellhart]] NPCs</i></b>
[[Couriers Tipp & Pill]]
| reward = {{R|260}} (Act 2)<br>{{R|290}} (Act 3)<br>[[Styx]] expands his nest, allowing for the generation of more [[Silkeater]]s.
}}
{{TaskEntry
| id = Songclave Supplies
| title = [[Songclave Supplies]]
| description = "Good-goods for the pilgrims up high! Thems brave ones, settled up on that big-big Citadel. These deliverings they will muchly need, miss courier. Carry them safe-safe, for us!"
| objective = Deliver supplies to the Caretaker in Songclave.
| location = <b><i>[[Bellhart]] NPCs</i></b>
[[Couriers Tipp & Pill]]
| reward = {{R|360}} (Act 2)<br>{{R|410}} (Act 3)
}}
{{TaskEntry
| id = Fleatopia Supplies
| title = [[Fleatopia Supplies]]
| description = "Those good-goods, all packed fresh for the clever fleas. Take thems up for us, miss courier. Maybe new friends you might be making with your service? Yes-yes?"
| objective = Deliver supplies to the Fleamaster Mooshka in Fleatopia.
| location = <b><i>[[Bellhart]] NPCs</i></b>
[[Couriers Tipp & Pill]]
| reward = {{R|410}} (Act 2)<br>{{R|480}} (Act 3)
}}
{{TaskEntry
| id = Liquid Lacquer
| title = [[Liquid Lacquer (Wish)|Liquid Lacquer]]
| description = "A delivery deadly, dangerous, fiercably cold, for old bug up there that does need it much-much! Serves us all he does, so we serve back. And great test for you, miss courier! Most challenging-challenge this. The lacquer to bring is sloshy-slosh. A hard carry even for the best."
| objective = Deliver Liquid Lacquer to the Mask Maker upon Mount Fay.
| location = <b><i>[[Bellhart]] NPCs</i></b>
[[Couriers Tipp & Pill]]
| reward = {{R|560}} (Act 2)<br>{{R|650}} (Act 3)
}}
{{TaskEntry
| bottom = true
| header = <b><i>Accessible in [[Act 3]]</i></b>
| id = Survivor's Camp Supplies
| title = [[Survivor's Camp Supplies]]
| description = "A new destination this-this! And desperate these supplies are asked. Deliverings for them-them escaped from the crumbled camp beside the bone, those few still living. Hurting and hungry, those few must be."
| objective = Deliver supplies to Flick at the Survivors' Camp.
| location = <b><i>[[Bellhart]] NPCs</i></b>
[[Couriers Tipp & Pill]]
| reward = {{R|180}}<br><i>Replaces [[Bone Bottom Supplies]] and [[Pilgrim's Rest Supplies]]</i>
}}
</div>
{{Clear}}<br>

== Unique Wishes ==
Unique Wishes each have their own unique task icon and subheader, and involve completing objectives that don't fit into any other type of Wish.
<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show List of Wishes" data-collapsetext="Hide List of Wishes">
{{TaskEntry
| top = true
| header = <b><i>Accessible in [[Act 1]]</i></b>
| id = Bugs of Pharloom
| title = [[File:Learn Quest Icon.png|100px]]<br>[[Bugs of Pharloom|LEARN:<br>Bugs of Pharloom]]
| description = "Would you help Nuu? Could you take her scroll, and fill its pages with the learnings of your cuts?"
| objective = Defeat the many creatures of Pharloom and fill out the Hunter's Journal.
| location = <b><i>[[Halfway Home]] NPC</i></b>
[[Nuu]]
| reward = [[Tool Pouch|Tool Pouch Expansion]]<br><i>[[Achievements (Silksong)|Keen Hunter]]</i>
}}
{{TaskEntry
| header = <b><i>Accessible in [[Act 3]]</i></b>
| id = Fastest in Pharloom
| title = [[File:Sprint Quest Icon.png|100px]]<br>[[Fastest in Pharloom|SPRINT:<br>Fastest in Pharloom]]
| description = Be you nimble? Be you quick? If you would prove yourself Pharloom's fastest bug, meet me at the furthest border of the Far Fields! With all haste!
| objective = Race Sprintmaster Swift to discover Pharloom's fastest bug.
| location = <b><i>[[Bellhart]] Wishwall / [[Far Fields]] NPC</i></b>
[[Sprintmaster Swift]]
| reward = First Race: [[Rosary Necklace]]<br>Second Race: [[Beast Shard]]<br>Third Race: [[Mask Shard (Silksong)|Mask Shard]]
}}
{{TaskEntry
| id = Passing of the Age
| title = [[File:Witness Quest Icon.png|100px]]<br>[[Passing of the Age (Wish)|WITNESS:<br>Passing of the Age]]
| description = "We speak the wish of the Master Herald, he who signs an Age's end."
| objective = Under chapel fallen to the monarch's might,<br>Over camp collapsed to the black thread plight,<br>Scorched field on edge, shells black and burned,<br>Up towers spinning, near the surgeon spurned,<br>Cage of one who raged against the silken lie,<br>Fell heart of frost, who soars on high,<br>Past cradle's peak, last test of fitness,<br>That the age may pass, this shroom its witness.
| location = <b><i>[[Putrified Ducts]] Riddle Tablet</i></b>
[[Mister Mushroom (Silksong)|The Herald]]
| reward = <i>[[Achievements (Silksong)|Passing of the Age]]</i>
}}
{{TaskEntry
| bottom = true
| header = <b><i>Accessible in {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)| Steel Soul Mode]]</i></b>
| id = A Vassal Lost
| title = [[File:Steel Quest Icon.png|100px]]<br>[[A Vassal Lost|STEEL:<br>A Vassal Lost]]
| description = "Creature, higher... It has been sent... by Masters served... to retrieve Zi's vassal lost?"
| objective = Investigate the resting sites marked by Steel Seer Zi to uncover the location of her vassal.
| location = <b><i>[[Blasted Steps]] NPC</i></b>
[[Steel Seer Zi]]
| reward = [[Growstone]]
}}
</div>
